options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the conversation log.

options.name: messages
options.description: Messages: { id, role, text, format?, timestamp?, author?, attachments?, status?, error?, feedback? }.

options.name: authors
options.description: Default author per role: { name, avatar?, icon? }.

options.name: suggestions
options.description: Suggestion chips above the composer: { id, label, text? } (hidden while streaming).

options.name: typing
options.description: Name of someone typing (people chats).

options.name: composer
options.description: Show the composer (Prompt Input).

options.name: prompt
options.description: Composer options (placeholder, attachments, accept, triggers, counter, submitKey, ...).

options.name: emptyText
options.description: Text shown while there are no messages.

options.name: copyable
options.description: Copy action on user and assistant messages (and on code blocks).

options.name: feedback
options.description: Thumbs up and down on finished assistant messages.

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Names holidays and non-working days in the day separators.

options.name: today
options.description: Reference day for Today and Yesterday; default today in the timezone.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: assistantFormat
options.description: Format of assistant and tool messages that do not set format.

options.name: showTimestamps
options.description: Show times and day separators.

options.name: showAvatars
options.description: Show avatars next to messages.

options.name: maxRenderedMessages
options.description: Most messages in the DOM (integer 20..2000); earlier ones are behind Show earlier messages.

options.name: headingLevel
options.description: Heading level of a Markdown # heading (integer 2..6).

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA timezone of times and day separators.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of labels, times, and dates.

properties.name: following
properties.description: Whether the log follows new content (the user has not scrolled up).

properties.name: prompt
properties.description: The composer, or null when composer is false.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Append a message, or replace the message with the same id.

methods.name: removeMessage
methods.description: Remove a message (stops it when it is streaming).

methods.name: stream
methods.signature: stream(source: ChatStreamSource | ((signal: AbortSignal) => ChatStreamSource), init?: ChatStreamInit): Promise<ChatMessage>
methods.description: Stream a reply into a new or existing message; resolves with the final message (complete, stopped, or error).

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop the streaming reply; emits aui-stop.

methods.name: scrollToLatest
methods.description: Scroll to the newest message and follow new content again.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the composer (or the log without one).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Stop streaming and remove rendering, listeners, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-send
events.description: The user sent a message or chose a suggestion: { text, attachments }; prevent it to keep the text and add no message.

events.name: aui-stop
events.description: A streaming reply was stopped (Stop or stop()): { id }.

events.name: aui-retry
events.description: Retry on a failed or stopped reply: { id, prompt } (the user message before it).

events.name: aui-feedback
events.description: The user rated a reply: { id, value: 'up' | 'down' | null }.

events.name: aui-suggestion
events.description: A suggestion chip was chosen: { suggestion }; prevent it to handle it yourself instead of sending its text.

events.name: aui-attachment-open
events.description: An attachment chip was activated: { messageId, attachment }.

contentAreas.name: messages[].text
contentAreas.description: Message text: plain text or the Markdown subset (never HTML).

cssClasses.name: aui-chat__viewport | __log
cssClasses.description: Scroll container (role=log) and its positioned wrapper.

cssClasses.name: aui-chat__earlier | __empty | __messages | __day
cssClasses.description: Show earlier button, empty text, message list, day separator.

cssClasses.name: aui-chat__message | __message--user | --assistant | --system | --tool | --error | --streaming
cssClasses.description: A message (article) and its role and state.

cssClasses.name: aui-chat__avatar | __avatar--icon | __body | __meta | __author | __time
cssClasses.description: Avatar and the author and time line.

cssClasses.name: aui-chat__bubble | __content | __content--markdown | __bubble--typing | __dots
cssClasses.description: Message text and the typing dots.

cssClasses.name: aui-chat__md-heading | __md-code | __md-link | __code | __code-head | __code-language | __code-copy | __code-body
cssClasses.description: Markdown headings, inline code, links, and code blocks.

cssClasses.name: aui-chat__typing | __jump | __suggestions | __suggestion | __composer
cssClasses.description: Typing row, Jump to latest, suggestion chips, composer host.
